identity.paletteUse: The four colours work as a set. Use them together inside the scenes (segments, ordered steps, data series, object fills), not one blue accent on gray.
gradients: four-colour sequence blue → red → yellow → green for progress, tracks and data
Gemini products: a blue-to-violet gradient and the four-point spark; verify the current official asset before using either
identity.shapes: Simple rounded geometry: circles, pills, rounded rectangles, generous corner radius.
motifs: clean product UI surfaces on white or near-black
the Gemini spark for Gemini subjects (official asset only)
identity.surface: Flat, bright and clean. Light surfaces are as on-brand as dark ones; avoid heavy glass or neon.
identity.motion: Friendly and precise: quick ease-out moves, small overshoot on dots and pills, no aggressive shake.
identity.confidence: descriptive — palette verified from the official logo; the rest describes Google's public identity and is not an official specification.

logoRules.note: Official Google logo/mark only. The four-color palette is the brand signal; do not use one color as if it were the whole identity.

notes: Four-color Google palette verified from the official logo. UI neutrals follow Google's dark-theme grays (approximate). Inspired by Google's public identity; not a Google publication.
